subtitle: Lesson 16 · Asynchronous JavaScript

caption: resolve(value) fulfills it; reject(error) rejects it.

code:
getBlockNumber
  .then((block) => console.log("Block:", block))
  .catch((err) => console.error("Failed:", err.message))
  .finally(() => console.log("Done checking."));
caption: finally runs no matter what — ideal for cleanup work.

code:
getUser(id)
  .then((user) => getBalance(user.address))
  .then((balance) => getTransactions(balance.account))
  .then((txs) => render(txs))
  .catch((err) => console.error("Pipeline failed:", err));
caption: One catch at the end covers failures from any step.
Resolves when all fulfill, or rejects on the first failure.
